description: The entity does not evaluate and communicate internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action.
applicability: Applies to all entities when control deficiencies are not identified, deficiencies are not communicated to responsible parties, remediation is not tracked, or there is no escalation process for significant deficiencies.

metadata.detection_notes: Review deficiency tracking systems, deficiency communication records, remediation plans, escalation procedures, and evidence of timely communication to management and board. Look for untracked deficiencies, lack of communication processes, or delayed remediation without proper escalation.
